verdict.rationale: Account- or company-level analysis is a fair axis for a product analytics platform, but the evidence pack never documents group, account, or company-level analytics. Every cited analytics capability (funnels, segmentation, cohorts, the identity model) is framed around individual users. The CRM integration listings (Salesforce, HubSpot) do not show account-level behavioral analysis in Amplitude itself.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can analyze behavior at the account or company level, not just per user, for B2B products
